parts.note_add: S-005 fig 5540A-1 (BI p49) draws socket 55261 with bulb 75115, the 194 12 V 3.4 W (PT626): this is the socket for the 194 bulbs. The same Mazda number is still listed by Mazda USA as a tachometer socket for the 1986 323; the page refused an automated read, so availability is unconfirmed.

S-005 fig 5540A-1 (BI p49) draws socket 55261A with bulb 75115A, the 74 1.4 W (PT627): this is the socket for the 74 bulbs. The catalogue lists 6 of these sockets but 8 of the 74 bulbs, so two 74 bulbs sit somewhere else (confirm on the car). No live listing for 3625-55-261 was found.

specs.note: The figure pairs socket 55261 with bulb 75115; the rows give 75115 = 0000-11-0194 (A12V 3.4W). Confirm on the car which of the cluster positions use this socket.
Matches the 9 bulbs 0000-11-0194 in the same figure.
Derived from the bulb the catalogue fits (194); the 194 is a T-3 1/4 glass wedge, 14 V 0.27 A. Confirm on the car.
The figure pairs socket 55261A with bulb 75115A; the rows give 75115A = 0000-11-0074 (1.4W). The S-001 decode also gives the warning lamps as 1.4 W. Confirm on the car.
Eight 74 bulbs are listed against six of these sockets; where the other two sit is not shown (confirm on the car).
